column1: # root<TAB>gloss -- the human decision for a root whose auto-selected Hans Wehr
# gloss is the wrong entry or the wrong sense. Nothing in the source picks a
# sense (hanswehr.sqlite's quran_occurrence is per headword, not per sense --
# see docs/plans/phase-24-gloss-quality.md), so this file is the only place
# An EMPTY gloss drops the root's hanswehr row entirely, letting Lane lead.
# `import-lane` upserts and never deletes, so dropping needs a prune first --
# but do NOT point `prune-definitions` at this file. It only knows the roots a
# human named, and the run also quarantines roots nothing chose (`no_gloss`,
# `not_in_hanswehr`), which keep their old row just the same. The prune list is
# generated: `prepare_hanswehr_glosses --prune-out` writes every root holding a
# hanswehr row this run did not re-produce, drops included.
# Applied after the Hans Wehr lookup, so it corrects which HW sense ships and
# cannot invent a gloss for a root HW does not carry. An override for a root
# HW has no entry for is therefore never applied -- it is reported as
# Populated by the Task 7 human gate from the `options` columns of
